wins: Maintained consistent high reward (90) despite single episode, indicating systematic action selection.
Used available mentor guidance efficiently across 10 calls to probe environment.
fails: Unable to complete objective; episode ended with 0% success despite numerous mentor interventions.

key_outcomes.summary: Agent showed disciplined exploration but failed to translate reconnaissance into successful completion; focus on closing decision-action gaps is needed.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to finalize exploit chain after initial reconnaissance, leading to episode termination before goal achievement.
